subject.title: fix(telegram): clear generic callback buttons after click

question: Should transient Telegram markup-edit failures prevent generic callback payload delivery until the retryable update succeeds?
rationale: Both choices are defensible: retry-first avoids processing an action while its reusable button remains visible, while best-effort cleanup prioritizes immediate payload delivery during Telegram API instability.

options.title: Accept Retry Before Delivery
options.body: Keep the current behavior, where permanent edit errors allow delivery but transient errors retry before routing the callback payload.

options.title: Make Cleanup Best-Effort
options.body: Route the callback payload despite every cleanup error and handle the risk of a temporarily reusable button through deduplication or later cleanup.

recommendation.title: Accept Retry Before Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep the current behavior, where permanent edit errors allow delivery but transient errors retry before routing the callback payload.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent Telegram bot-handler refactor history is closest to the ordering and retry contract being decided.
